create_swin_config: create a SwinConfig instance with custom embed_dim, depths, and num_heads for a Swin Transformer model
initialize_swin_model: initialize a SwinModel with a SwinConfig to build a vision transformer with random weights
configure_swin_window_size: configure SwinConfig with a custom window_size and patch_size for image input processing
set_swin_output_features: set output features and indices on SwinConfig using out_indices and out_features parameters
access_swin_model_config: access the SwinConfig from a trained SwinModel via the model.config attribute
